episodes.synopsis: Gaku possesses outstanding computer skills but is socially awkward. Haru's only talent is talking. After graduating from university, Haru wants to use Gaku's abilities to fulfill his childhood dream—to earn a trillion dollars.
episodes.title: The World's Most Selfish Man

episodes.synopsis: After Haru blows their entire startup capital on an expensive office chair, the two young entrepreneurs set out to find a generous investor. There's only one problem: They haven't achieved anything, nor do they have any idea for their business model.
episodes.title: START UP

episodes.synopsis: Kirika offers to invest in Haru and Gaku for a 51% shareholding ratio, which would give her control over their company. Haru uses her offer as a weapon and enters a hacking tournament in order to attract other investors.
episodes.title: You'll Win, Won't You?

episodes.synopsis: The preliminary phase of the Security Championship is nearing its conclusion. Will Haru and Gaku manage to secure a spot among the top 12 teams and reach the finals?
episodes.title: A Bad Guy

episodes.synopsis: Haru and Gaku compete as the only second team in the final round of the Security Championship. But right from the start, Haru demonstrates that he can contribute to the duo's victory even without IT skills.
episodes.title: The Maiden's Gaze

episodes.synopsis: Gaku and Haru win the Security Championship, but they're disqualified after a complaint over their physical attack against the other competitors. However, investor Kedoin Kazuki is drawn to their abilities and reaches out to them.
episodes.title: I Want You To the Moon

episodes.synopsis: With the name of the company settled, Haru and Gaku move on to hiring personnel. But which of the five applicants would be most suited to the job, especially when it hasn't been decided what the "job" is yet?
episodes.title: Trillion Game, Inc

episodes.synopsis: The trio is trying to launch an online shop where customers receive advice from a seemingly AI that appears as a VTuber avatar. Soon, they also discover which market they can specialize in.
episodes.title: Flowers and Splendor

episodes.synopsis: Haru and Gaku begin working as hosts in Shinjuku's Kabukicho to better understand their target market.
episodes.title: The Flower Way of Kabuki

episodes.synopsis: Haru and Gaku's AI specialty shop catches the attention of Dragon Bank, who uses their media empire to bring them down. Not one to be beaten, Haru immediately begins preparing a counterattack.
episodes.title: GOLDEN EGG

episodes.synopsis: Trillion Game, Inc. invites investors to a private information session for their new social game project, which includes an appearance from a surprising guest.
episodes.title: The Illusory Man

episodes.synopsis: Haru and Kedoin visit God Promotion, Kedoin's former employer, to make a deal.
episodes.title: Two Bad Guys

episodes.synopsis: Trillion Game, Inc. takes over God Promotion's shareholder meeting, and Gaku learns the shocking truth about Haru's plans for Sakura and his team of game designers.
episodes.title: The Decisive Battle!!

episodes.synopsis: Rinrin is furious when she learns the game development project was merely a pawn, but Gaku stops her from going to speak with Haru. If Gaku must fight Haru, then he'd rather do it his way. He reveals the situation to Sakura's team, and together they plan to create a game that exceeds what Haru planned for them. That said, it's a difficult task for a team that's never produced a hit game before.
episodes.title: Haru vs. Gaku

episodes.synopsis: Gaku goes on a date with Kirihime to an amusement park. Though she seems to be enjoying herself like an ordinary girl, Gaku suspects that their "date" is a cover to discuss business.
episodes.title: With You

episodes.synopsis: Gaku and Rinrin meet with Hebijima, the creator of Dragon Bank's hit game Dragon Musume, to offer him a job at Trillion Game, Inc. Negotiations immediately hit a snag when the topic of pay comes up.
episodes.title: I LOVE MONEY

episodes.synopsis: Haru begins networking and making connections in order to build his media empire. Meanwhile, Rinrin has some bad news to share regarding the financial situation of Trillion Game, Inc.
episodes.title: Haru Unparalleled

episodes.synopsis: Haru fabricates a scandal in order to form a business alliance with Sumeragi Entertainment, the most powerful corporation in the industry.
episodes.title: The IT Cup

episodes.synopsis: Trillion Game, Inc. brainstorms ways to get players to pay for a free mobile game.
episodes.title: Look At the Sky Instead of the Peak

episodes.synopsis: Gaku meets his high school crush at a class reunion.
episodes.title: The Price of Glory

episodes.synopsis: President Kokuryu of Dragon Bank makes Gaku, Haru, and Kedoin an offer they have no reason to refuse.
episodes.title: The Dragon King's Palm

episodes.synopsis: Trillion Game, Inc. takes a company trip to Las Vegas.
episodes.title: ALL IN

episodes.synopsis: Trillion Game, Inc. goes head-to-head against Dragon Bank in the media industry.
episodes.title: MEDIA WARS

episodes.synopsis: Trillion Game, Inc. proposes a partnership with Kawara TV.
episodes.title: I LOVE NEWS

episodes.synopsis: Trillion Game, Inc. and Kawara TV's Kunugi and Akari get to work producing Trillion News.
episodes.title: THE COLLAR OF MONEY

episodes.synopsis: Haru engineers a scenario in which Trillion News, Kawara TV, and the Mithril phone's manufacturer all come out ahead.
episodes.title: GAME CHANGER
